page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 52 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture operates with a single thread per core configuration, ensuring dedicated compute resources without simultaneous multithreading overhead.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps. There are no hardware GPU accelerators bundled with this configuration.

The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, making this instance unsuitable for heavy graphics processing or high-IOPS local caching workloads. However, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated physical cores offer qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable CPU performance without hyperthreading interference. Appropriate workloads include medium-to-large databases, in-memory caching, enterprise applications, and data processing pipelines.

Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz, the x86_64 architecture utilizes a single thread per core configuration to deliver predictable compute performance. The instance provides a memory density of 7.38 GB per vCPU and a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, requiring network-attached storage for all data persistence. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, such as relational databases, in-memory data stores, and enterprise applications, where dedicated CPU allocation and high memory capacity are critical, while avoiding the overhead of simultaneous multithreading.
